name: Ashes Remember Us
description:
About This Game

Ashes Remember Us – a horde-based arcade roguelike with tower defense elements and inventory management.
Only one thing matters: your survival.
How long can you hold out?

The world has fallen. All that remains is you, the mutants - and a few lunatics who somehow got their hands on a plane and occasionally drop you airdrops. As the clock keeps ticking mercilessly, you fight for every second.

Inventory Management & Builds

Your inventory is the key to survival.

Modules come in different shapes and must fit into a limited grid. Every slot counts. Every decision matters.

Place, rotate, and combine your modules to create powerful synergies.

Will it still fit? Or do you sacrifice something better?

What you carry defines your run.

Your Base, Your Life

Your base is your last refuge. Lose it, and you’re dead. The mutants are drawn to it like moths to a flame - so defend it with everything you’ve got.

Weapons & Mods

You like weapons? Perfect. Every weapon has its own base stats and can be modified with modules that combine in wild ways. More damage? More piercing? More range? No problem - with the right mods, you can turn any gun into something unique.

Defense

Your defenses are set - now it’s all about the right setup. Upgrade your fixed towers with weapon modules and shape their playstyle to fit your strategy. Every decision changes your build - fast, precise, or pure destruction.

New modules come from airdrops. Everything is random—you work with what you get.

Whether it’s piercing, area damage, or status effects:

Combine modules, strengthen your builds, and get the most out of your defenses.

Mutants & Bosses

Mutants come in all forms: fast, slow, ranged, tanky, or hard to hit. One thing they all have in common - they want to devour you.

To keep things interesting, bosses appear regularly. Big, small, nasty - doesn’t matter, they’re bosses. Whether they show up at fixed intervals or randomly might be decided later. One thing is certain: they want to destroy you.

Events & Chaos

To make the chaos complete, events occur completely unpredictably. Strange rain? Tremors? Who knows what’s coming next. One thing’s for sure—it’s only going to get worse.

Ashes Remember Us – a roguelike where every run is different.

Are you ready to defend your base—until the bitter end?
short_desc: Ashes Remember Us is a horde survival roguelike where your inventory decides if you survive. Build powerful loadouts in a tight grid, upgrade your weapons, defend your base, and fight endless mutant hordes. Every run is different - how long can you last?
